prompt: How many non-brand TikTok accounts have reached more than 50 million followers?
answer:
As of the latest figures available (October 23, 2026), **34 non-brand TikTok accounts** had more than 50 million followers.

This comes from 42 total accounts above 50 million, minus 8 official brand/organization accounts, including TikTok, FIFA World Cup, Real Madrid, FC Barcelona, ESPN, Champions League, PSG, and Netflix.
